sampling: Uniform deterministic hash sample of up to1500 stint-sides per season/cutoff; aggregation proportional to actual fractional possessions. Hash selection excludes all outcome values. Joint lineup simulations shared across sampled sides.
denominator: opposite team defensivePossessions for attacking exposure, own defensivePossessions for defending exposure; fractional overlap attribution. Zero-possession points retained in real totals, no division by zero on individual stints.
baseline: Real baseline all strict training stints for each team. Sim baseline selected sample per team, estimated with actual pre-cutoff exposure weights. Sampling uncertainty reported. Supplemental selected-real baseline sensitivity also computed.
pairing: Sort each five-player roster by stored position PG/SG/SF/PF/C then playerID; retain card courtPosition and attributes. Actual defensive matchups not observed; no adaptive matchup.
seedRule: Three common independent seeds20261012,20261013,20261014 per unique joint lineup, fixed48min, no fatigue/substitution/foul-out/overtime, same calibrated v3 constants with five signals off.
limitations: Observed lineup association confounded by opponent/game state; fixed-lineup engine vs stint association is not causal validation. Rare groups with<500 offensive or defensive possessions flagged insufficient, not dropped.
